description: This is a shell script that provides command-line functionality for managing OCI containers, including starting, stopping, listing, inspecting, pausing, resuming, and executing commands within containers. It interacts with a remote service via curl to perform these operations, and contains multiple functions and a command loop for user interaction.

methods.name: start_container_from_bundle
methods.description: Starts a container from an OCI bundle located either by path or name, sending a JSON-RPC request via curl.

methods.name: start_container_from_spec
methods.description: Starts a container from a Dobby spec JSON file, sending a JSON-RPC request via curl.

methods.name: stop_container
methods.description: Stops a specified container by sending a JSON-RPC request.

methods.name: list_containers
methods.description: Lists all running containers by sending a JSON-RPC request.

methods.name: get_container_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific container.

methods.name: get_container_state
methods.description: Retrieves the state of a specific container.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container with optional arguments.

methods.name: ocicontainer_help
methods.description: Displays help information about available commands.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main loop that reads user commands and invokes corresponding functions.
